summary: This TechnicalRoundup episode discusses the crypto market in early 2023 with Cred and Duck. Bitcoin remains range-bound between $16.2k-$17k with minimal volatility despite macro catalysts. Duck shows bullish bias on Bitcoin above $17.2k, while Cred remains more cautious. Ethereum shows strength near $1.3k with targets at $1.5k and potentially $2.5k if it breaks through. Duck is strongly bullish on Litecoin with a swing trade targeting $100-$120 initially, then $220. Solana is discussed as bullish around $12 with targets up to $15-$19. Tron shows interesting technical setup on BTC pair despite Justin Sun concerns. Major industry issues discussed include Three Arrows Capital, Genesis, Voyager, Silvergate, and ongoing FTX fallout.
